children: US stock futures slipped on Wednesday as investors monitored the midterm election results and assessed the latest corporate earnings.
Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures were all down about 0.2%.
Preliminary polls indicated a potential shift in control of the House of Representatives to Democrats, while the Senate race remained uncertain.
Investors are concerned that a Democratic victory across both chambers could bring tighter regulation of the AI sector and increased corporate oversight.
On the corporate front, AMD surged more than 6% in after-hours trading after reporting stronger-than-expected third-quarter earnings and revenue, boosting shares of other semiconductor companies.
Super Micro Computer and Arista Networks also advanced following better-than-expected quarterly results.
During Tuesday’s regular session, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite rose 0.36% and 0.83%, respectively, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average declined 0.38%.

title: US Futures Slip as Midterm Election Results Awaited
